title: PolicyCenter Engine Outage - November 2 RCA
body: On 2025-11-02 at 08:15 UTC, PolicyCenter policy engine became unresponsive. All policy creation and modification operations failed. Root Cause: Memory leak in renewal engine calculations. Service hung when processing 50k+ policies in monthly renewal batch.
root_cause: Memory leak in renewal engine v2.1.5 when processing bulk renewal operations. Garbage collection not triggered properly for large object arrays.
corrective_actions: 1. Patched renewal engine memory leak (commit abc123). 2. Added memory monitoring alert at 75% heap. 3. Implemented GC hint before bulk operations.

title: Customer reports login issues
body: Customer unable to log into the portal. Error message: 'Authentication service timeout'. Has tried clearing browser cache. Same error on different machines. Issue is intermittent - works sometimes, fails other times.

title: ClaimCenter DB Connection Pool Exhaustion - Incident Analysis
body: ClaimCenter database connection pool exhausted on 2025-11-08 after 3 hours of elevated claim processing load. New connections timed out after 30 seconds. Root cause: max_connections limit of 100 was too low for sustained claim batch processing. During peak hours, claim submission + approval workflows use ~120 concurrent connections.
root_cause: Database max_connections limit (100) was lower than peak concurrent demand (~120 for claim workflows). No connection pool size validation logic in application layer.
corrective_actions: 1. Increased max_connections from 100 to 250. 2. Added application-level connection pool metrics. 3. Set alert if >80% pool utilization.
